6:["$","p",null,{"children":"There is one important cap: your overseas and Australian work experience are combined, and the total cannot exceed 20 points."}]
7:["$","h2",null,{"children":"Points Calculation by Category"}]
8:["$","h3",null,{"children":"Age (Up to 30 points)"}]
9:["$","p",null,{"children":"Points are awarded based on your age at the time of invitation. The 25–32 age bracket receives the maximum 30 points. Points decrease gradually for older applicants. If you are 45 or older, you are not eligible."}]
a:["$","h3",null,{"children":"English Language (Up to 20 points)"}]
b:["$","p",null,{"children":"English proficiency is assessed through recognised tests. Competent English (e.g., IELTS 6.0 each band) gives 0 points. Proficient (IELTS 7.0) gives 10 points. Superior (IELTS 8.0) gives 20 points. This category alone can make a significant difference in your total."}]
c:["$","h3",null,{"children":"Work Experience (Up to 20 points combined)"}]
d:["$","p",null,{"children":"Both overseas and Australian skilled employment are scored separately but are subject to a combined cap of 20 points. Each uses different time brackets. You cannot simply add the maximum from both categories."}]
e:["$","h3",null,{"children":"Education (Up to 20 points)"}]
f:["$","p",null,{"children":"Your highest completed qualification determines your education points. A PhD gives 20 points, a Bachelor's or Master's gives 15, and a Diploma or Trade gives 10. Points are awarded for the highest qualification only."}]
10:["$","h3",null,{"children":"Bonus Categories (Up to 25 points)"}]
11:["$","p",null,{"children":"Several smaller categories can each add 5 points: Australian study, regional study, professional year, and community language (NAATI). There is also a specialist education category worth up to 10 points for STEM research degrees from Australian institutions."}]
12:["$","h3",null,{"children":"Partner and Nomination (Up to 25 points)"}]
13:["$","p",null,{"children":"Partner skills can add up to 10 points. State nomination adds either 5 points (190 visa) or 15 points (491 visa)."}]
14:["$","h2",null,{"children":"What Is the Maximum PR Points Score?"}]
15:["$","p",null,{"children":"The theoretical maximum PR points Australia score is 150 points when combining all categories. However, this is extremely rare because of the work experience cap. In practice, most applicants score between 65 and 100 points."}]
16:["$","p",null,{"children":["A score of 85+ is generally considered very competitive. You can check what qualifies as a"," ",["$","$L5",null,{"href":"/articles/what-is-good-pr-score-australia","className":"text-blue-700 hover:underline","children":"good PR score Australia"}]," ","on our detailed guide."]}]
17:["$","div",null,{"className":"bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 rounded-lg p-5 my-6 text-center","children":[["$","p",null,{"className":"text-gray-700 mb-3","children":"Want to see how your points add up? Try our calculator."}],["$","$L5",null,{"href":"/tools/pr-points-calculator","className":"inline-flex items-center px-6 py-3 bg-blue-700 text-white font-medium rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-800 transition-colors","children":"Calculate Your PR Points →"}]]}]
18:["$","h2",null,{"children":"Understanding the Work Experience Cap"}]
19:["$","p",null,{"children":"The work experience cap is one of the most commonly misunderstood aspects of the PR points calculation. Here is how it works:"}]
1a:["$","p",null,{"children":"Suppose you have 8 years of overseas experience (15 points) and 5 years of Australian experience (15 points). Your combined total would be 30 points. However, the cap limits you to 20 points total, so you lose 10 points."}]
1b:["$","p",null,{"children":"This means it is important to plan strategically. If you already have significant overseas experience, gaining Australian experience may not add as many points as you expect."}]
1c:["$","h2",null,{"children":"Important Calculation Rules"}]
1d:["$","h3",null,{"children":"Highest Qualification Only"}]
1e:["$","p",null,{"children":"You cannot stack education points. If you have both a Diploma (10 points) and a Master's degree (15 points), you only receive 15 points for the Master's."}]
1f:["$","h3",null,{"children":"Points Must Be Current"}]
20:["$","p",null,{"children":"Work experience must be within the last 10 years. English test results must be from within the last 3 years. Expired evidence means no points."}]
21:["$","h3",null,{"children":"Partner Points Are Separate"}]
22:["$","p",null,{"children":"Your partner's points are added to your total, not claimed separately. If your partner does not meet any criteria, you simply get 0 points for the partner category."}]
23:["$","h3",null,{"children":"Nomination Points Are Additive"}]
24:["$","p",null,{"children":"State nomination points are added on top of your base score. A 190 nomination adds 5 points, and a 491 nomination adds 15 points to whatever you already have."}]
25:["$","h2",null,{"children":"Calculation Scenarios"}]
26:["$","h3",null,{"children":"Scenario 1: Young Graduate"}]
27:["$","p",null,{"children":["Age 26 (30) + Superior English (20) + Bachelor's degree (15) + Australian study (5) + single (10) = ",["$","strong",null,{"children":"80 points"}],". This is a competitive score, especially for state nomination."]}]
28:["$","h3",null,{"children":"Scenario 2: Experienced Professional"}]
29:["$","p",null,{"children":["Age 35 (25) + Proficient English (10) + 5 years overseas work (10) + 3 years Australian work (10) + Master's (15) + partner with English (5) ="," ",["$","strong",null,{"children":"75 points"}],". Note that work experience is capped at 20 combined."]}]
2a:["$","h3",null,{"children":"Scenario 3: State Nominated Applicant"}]
2b:["$","p",null,{"children":["Age 30 (30) + Proficient English (10) + 3 years overseas work (5) + 2 years Australian work (5) + Bachelor's (15) + professional year (5) + 190 nomination (5) = ",["$","strong",null,{"children":"75 points"}],"."]}]
2c:["$","h2",null,{"children":"Calculate Your Own PR Points"}]
2d:["$","p",null,{"children":"Now that you understand how the calculation works, try it yourself. Our calculator walks you through each category and applies the rules automatically."}]
2e:["$","div",null,{"className":"bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 rounded-lg p-5 my-8 text-center","children":[["$","p",null,{"className":"text-gray-700 mb-3","children":"See your estimated score in under 2 minutes."}],["$","$L5",null,{"href":"/tools/pr-points-calculator","className":"inline-flex items-center px-6 py-3 bg-blue-700 text-white font-medium rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-800 transition-colors","children":"Launch PR Points Calculator →"}]]}]
